item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Policy-controlled state transition evaluation.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate a transition request without modifying either input.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    edge_key = f\\\"{request.get('from')}>{request.get('to')}\\\"\\n    edges = policy.get(\\\"edges\\\", {})\\n\\n    if edge_key not in edges:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"blocked\\\"}\\n\\n    edge = edges[edge_key]\\n    if \\\"role\\\" in edge and request.get(\\\"role\\\") != edge[\\\"role\\\"]:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"permission\\\"}\\n\\n    if request.get(\\\"retry\\\"):\\n        attempts = request.get(\\\"attempts\\\")\\n        retry_limit = policy.get(\\\"retry_limit\\\")\\n        valid_attempts = (\\n            isinstance(attempts, int)\\n            and not isinstance(attempts, bool)\\n            and isinstance(retry_limit, int)\\n            and not isinstance(retry_limit, bool)\\n            and 0 <= attempts < retry_limit\\n        )\\n        if not valid_attempts:\\n            return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"value\\\": None, \\\"reason\\\": \\\"retry_limit\\\"}\\n\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"value\\\": request.get(\\\"to\\\"), \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n    \\\"value\\\": \\\"ready\\\",\\n    \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"\\n  },\\n  {\\n    \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n    \\\"value\\\": \\\"running\\\",\\n    \\\"reason\\\": \\\"ok\\\"\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}}]}"}
